wnba.Headline: Valkyries face the Mystics on 8-game win streak
wnba.Description: Washington Mystics (12-11, 8-5 Eastern Conference) at Golden State Valkyries (18-7, 7-5 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Fire hold the Mystics to 29% shooting in a 75-56 rout
wnba.Description: — Carla Leite scored 14 points, Serah Williams had 12 points and the Portland Fire beat the Washington Mystics 75-56 on Thursday night.

wnba.Headline: NBA's Silver says Fever's Clark has become 'political football'
wnba.Description: NBA commissioner Adam Silver said Fever star Caitlin Clark has become a "political football" amid debates about officiating and physical play in the WNBA.

wnba.Headline: Igor Kokoskov joins Project B as head of player development
wnba.Description: Longtime NBA assistant Igor Kokoskov has joined the startup men's and women's basketball league Project B as its head of player development, the organization announced Thursday.

wnba.Headline: Ranking the WNBA's top 10 rim protectors of all time
wnba.Description: A'ja Wilson, Brittney Griner and Breanna Stewart already rank among the best shot blockers, rebounders and post presences.

wnba.Headline: Seattle visits Indiana following Johnson's 25-point performance
wnba.Description: Seattle Storm (6-20, 1-12 Western Conference) at Indiana Fever (14-10, 5-4 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Connecticut visits Phoenix after Edwards' 21-point game
wnba.Description: Connecticut Sun (6-18, 2-8 Eastern Conference) at Phoenix Mercury (8-17, 5-10 Western Conference)

wnba.Headline: Chicago hosts Los Angeles after Burrell's 24-point outing
wnba.Description: Los Angeles Sparks (10-13, 5-7 Western Conference) at Chicago Sky (8-16, 1-7 Eastern Conference)

wnba.Headline: Fever's Caitlin Clark sounds off on non-call in loss to Valkyries
wnba.Description: Caitlin Clark was frustrated by a non-call midway through the second quarter Wednesday night and sounded off after the Fever's 88-75 loss to the Valkyries.

wnba.Headline: Valkyries beat the Fever 88-75 for 8th straight victory
wnba.Description: — Gabby Williams scored 16 points, Kaitlyn Chen had 14 points, all in the second half, and the Golden State Valkyries beat the Indiana Fever 88-75 on Wednesday night for the second-year franchise's record eighth straight victory.

wnba.Headline: Indiana Fever vs. Golden State Valkyries - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Indiana Fever vs. Golden State Valkyries, 07/15/2026

wnba.Headline: Full list of every ESPYS 2026 award winner
wnba.Description: From Jalen Brunson to A'ja Wilson, see which athletes won at the 2026 ESPYS.

wnba.Headline: Cynthia Cooper, Teresa Weatherspoon excited about their ASG rosters
wnba.Description: Cynthia Cooper, Teresa Weatherspoon excited about their ASG rosters

wnba.Headline: Teresa Weatherspoon, Cynthia Cooper pick WNBA All-Star teams
wnba.Description: Teresa Weatherspoon bragged about the competitiveness of her team as the 2026 WNBA All-Star draft concluded Wednesday. Her All-Star general manager counterpart Cynthia Cooper said in response: "But can you score enough points?"

wnba.Headline: Lynx beat the Sparks 96-87 behind Kayla McBride's 5th straight 20-point game
wnba.Description: — Kayla McBride scored 24 for her fifth straight 20-point performance, Courtney Williams added 19 points, and the Minnesota Lynx beat the Los Angeles Sparks 96-87 on Wednesday for their fourth straight victory.

wnba.Headline: Minnesota Lynx vs. Los Angeles Sparks - Game Highlights
wnba.Description: Watch the Game Highlights from Minnesota Lynx vs. Los Angeles Sparks, 07/15/2026

wnba.Headline: Azura Stevens scores 18 of her 20 points in the 1st half and the Sky beat the Storm 95-90
wnba.Description: — Azura Stevens scored 18 of her 20 points in the first half, Sydney Taylor added 17 points, and the Chicago Sky beat the Seattle Storm 95-90 on Wednesday.
